name: Building Code of Pakistan (Seismic Provisions 2007) with ACI 318
description: The Building Code of Pakistan, Seismic Provisions 2007 (alpha 9 track C16), a pack that extends the US pack aci318-asce7-22: the seismic zones 1, 2A, 2B, 3 and 4 with Z 0.075 to 0.4, the soil profiles SA-SF and the UBC 1997 form of the static and dynamic procedures (seismic coefficients Ca and Cv, near-source factors Na and Nv in zone 4, V = Cv I W / R T within 2.5 Ca I W / R and 0.11 Ca I W, the response modification factors R and Ω0, the period Ct hn^(3/4), the storey drift), the towns' zones and the importance factors. The structural concrete is ACI 318 (the base pack's ACI 318-19, US bar sizes as rolled in Pakistan); the wind, the live loads and the load combinations are the base pack's ASCE 7-22 (BCP SP-2007 covers the seismic provisions only); the wind speeds of the towns are placeholders. Every value is listed in VERIFY.md; the town zones are uncertain and must be checked against the zoning map before design.
